title: OIG-Bench: A Multi-Agent Annotated Benchmark for Multimodal One-Image Guides Understanding
reasoning: The paper introduces a technical benchmark (OIG-Bench) for evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models on their ability to understand 'One-Image Guides' such as infographics, travel itineraries, and gaming charts. The evaluation focuses on capabilities like text recognition, semantic consistency, detail coverage, and reasoning ability, with no focus on religious, moral, or ethical topics.
